offline_stress_report.measurements: synthetic local ToolSearchIndex build/search only; no provider/cache-refresh measurements

provenance.qualification_runtime_note: The 54 qualification trials used a binary built before the final CLI restrictive-hook scope and aggregate/deferred-server bound fixes. That binary was overwritten by the final rebuild, and no matching pre-fix binary or full source hash snapshot was retained. The post-fix smoke used the rebuilt final binary.
provenance.report_format: full Mira JSONL transcripts compressed with deterministic gzip (mtime 0); hashes below cover compressed bytes
provenance.source_state_note: The study ran against the shared working tree, which contained uncommitted Framework/platform changes; baseline commit alone does not reproduce the tested source state.

axes.primary: readonly-ticket + staged-rollback; catalogs 600 and 2000; one server; native, cli, hybrid; 3 trials each
axes.server_description: description-only disambiguation; catalogs 600 and 2000; ten servers; native, cli, hybrid; 3 trials each

separate_evidence.concurrency3_initial_attempt: 9 attempts: 6 passes and 3 model-not-available provider errors; errors are infrastructure availability, not subject failures. The original run used the earlier classifier, so raw error_kind remains Subject; normalized classification is Infra in this summary.
separate_evidence.interrupted_filter_attempt: A 600-tool command used substring filter servers=1, which also selected servers=10. It was interrupted after a ten-server case appeared; the runner had not flushed a JSONL report, so the number of completed trials is unknown. Excluded from qualification and no output report retained.
separate_evidence.post_fix_smoke: 2 CLI cases at 2000 tools, one server: read-only and staged rollback; 2/2 passed. Excluded from qualification count.
separate_evidence.smoke_from_initial_connectivity_check: one old-binary 50-tool native ticket read passed, but it was kept in /tmp and excluded from canonical evidence.

usage_note: Usage corrected from retained generation events once per reasoning iteration. Input is uncached; cache-read is separate. The prior recursive projection counted each usage five times and missed actual provider cost. Provider-reported effective costs are observations, not invoice reconciliation. Original archives and all task scores are unchanged.
